You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From b68a1a933fe4a52a8316d214e3421f2a89bc113e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Edwin Peer <edwin.peer@broadcom.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2021 02:38:00 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] bnxt_en: fix format specifier in live patch error message

This fixes type mismatch warning.

Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Fixes: 3c4153394e2c ("bnxt_en: implement firmware live patching")
Signed-off-by: Edwin Peer <edwin.peer@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Chan <michael.chan@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_devlink.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_devlink.c
index a0a9af402642..6fe9e9b59f83 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_devlink.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_devlink.c
@@ -360,7 +360,7 @@ bnxt_dl_livepatch_report_err(struct bnxt *bp, struct netlink_ext_ack *extack,
 		NL_SET_ERR_MSG_MOD(extack, "Live patch already applied");
 		break;
 	default:
-		netdev_err(bp->dev, "Unexpected live patch error: %hhd\n", err);
+		netdev_err(bp->dev, "Unexpected live patch error: %d\n", err);
 		NL_SET_ERR_MSG_MOD(extack, "Failed to activate live patch");
 		break;
 	}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `bnxt_devlink.c`**
   - The format specifier in the error message for unexpected live patch errors was changed from `%hhd` to `%d`. This change addresses a type mismatch warning by ensuring that the variable `err`, which is likely an integer, is printed correctly.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `bnxt_devlink.c` is directly related to fixing a type mismatch warning that was reported by the kernel test robot. The change improves the clarity and correctness of the error message generated when an unexpected live patch error occurs, ensuring that the error code is displayed in the appropriate format. This fix is linked to a previous commit that implemented firmware live patching, indicating that the error handling needed refinement after that implementation.
